content:
rachael: Security advisory — effective policy change: all staff with admin or elevated console access must register a FIDO2 (WebAuthn) hardware key (YubiKey / Titan / equivalent) by 2026-04-20. This replaces SMS/OTP for admin flows and will be enforced in SSO for the Admin group. Please read and ack if you own any admin-level service or automation.

security-bot: Automated scan summary: 124 accounts in Admin group; 48 currently have no MFA methods registered or are using legacy SMS OTP. Details and per-owner list posted to secure ticket RW-Sec-1208.

rach ael: Why FIDO2? It gives phishing-resistant MFA, simpler pushless UX for admins, and complies with upcoming compliance requirements. We will NOT remove 2FA completely for regular users — this specifically targets elevated/admin access.

sylas: Ack. What's the exact rollout timeline and enforcement behavior?

rachael: Timeline:
- 2026-03-24: announcement (this thread) + registration guide published
- 2026-03-25 to 2026-04-10: grace period for self-registration; helpdesk/office-hours available
- 2026-04-11 to 2026-04-20: enforcement previews (warning screens during login)
- 2026-04-20 00:00 UTC: enforcement enabled — Admin-group logins require a registered FIDO2 device or an approved exception

infra-ops: For automation and CI (non-human service accounts) — do not require hardware keys. Instead, migrate to scoped service roles, ephemeral tokens, or use our token-vault with short TTL. We'll publish automation migration guidance.

helpdesk: We'll run drop-in sessions and a self-service flow. Link to guide and registration page: https://intra.redwood/docs/fido2-admin-setup. Office hours: 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC and 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.

security-bot: Quick checklist for owners: `owner: service/person - role: admin/automation - action: registered/migrated/exception-requested - notes`

sylas: owner: infra-console - role: admin - action: registered - notes: primary admin keys registered, secondary key scheduled. Verified access to console.

rachael: Exceptions: allowed only for broken-device cases or emergency automation with documented mitigation. File RW-Sec-EXCEPT with owner, justification, and expiry (max 60 days). Exceptions are temporary and logged.

infra-ops: Question: some SSO flows use browser-less API auth for administration (e.g., headless scripts). How do we enforce without breaking tooling?

rachael: For headless flows, migrate to machine principals and short-lived tokens (token vault) or corporate bastions that perform user-authenticated actions on behalf of a registered user. We'll publish examples and help with migration.

helpdesk: Registration notes: bring two FIDO2 devices if possible (primary + backup). If you lose your primary, backup device or exception request required. We can also register a U2F fallback if your key supports it.

oncall-bot: Enforcement flag scheduled: 2026-04-20 00:00 UTC. Preview banner will start 2026-04-11.

security-bot: Implementation details (high level): Okta SSO configured to require WebAuthn factor for Admin group; login flows will prompt WebAuthn API. Fallback challenge will be disabled for admin scope after enforcement.

rachael: If you're an admin and cannot obtain a hardware key before the deadline, open an exception ticket immediately and include timeline + mitigation. Note: exceptions are reviewed and rarely approved without a clear migration plan.

infra-ops: owner: automation-deploy - role: automation - action: migration-planned - notes: moving deployer bots to ephemeral tokens & service roles, ETA 2026-04-12.

sylas: owner: sec-ops - role: admin - action: registered - notes: primary and backup keys enrolled, access verified.

helpdesk: We'll provide bulk-enrollment support for teams that need help with 20+ admins. Contact helpdesk-private to schedule.

rachael: Post-finalization: we'll add a policy block preventing registration of SMS OTP for Admin group and audit org-wide factor usage quarterly. Also adding monitoring alert for failed WebAuthn attempts to detect potential targeted attacks.

security-bot: Reminder: document and attach proof of registration for compliance audits if your role is customer-facing or has access to PII.

rachael: Thanks everyone. Please post status updates here using the checklist format. We'll close the thread once all admins are registered or have approved exceptions. :key:
